purpose: Ensure Venue Chat does not stop at source-only coverage gaps when registered Production evidence can be closed through pre-race supplemental source acquisition, while preserving FULL_REQUIRED and no-synthesis rules.
rule: Run Signed SOURCE and source-to-feature compilation first.
If source-only Production coverage is insufficient, do not immediately terminate while pre-race time and registered Production-authorized sources remain available.
Resolve the minimum missing evidence needed to satisfy every Base Index coverage floor and all six DCR components.
Acquire only pre-cutoff Production-authorized supplemental sources; freeze source identity, origin, available_at, ingested_at and content SHA256.
Bind every supplemental feature to an already-registered rule_id and finite Production category; no freehand numeric score is allowed.
Re-run Evidence Feature Compiler and Production Evidence-to-Base materialization.
Proceed to Static Freeze/PRE_KRS/KRS/MEC/Capital/FINAL only when FULL_REQUIRED is actually satisfied.
If a required category semantics or source domain is not Production-authorized, fail closed; do not promote SHADOW objective rules or neutralize UNKNOWN.
minimum_closure_principle: MINIMUM REGISTERED EVIDENCE REQUIRED TO SATISFY INDEX COVERAGE FLOORS + COMPLETE DCR; NOT MAXIMUM FEATURE COUNT
final_block_condition: After required supplemental closure attempt, any Base Index coverage below current profile floor, unresolved DCR component, unregistered rule, post-cutoff source, or missing provenance remains.
known_limitations: Some domains still lack Production-authorized executable evaluator semantics or source adapters.
This repair changes execution routing and evidence closure behavior only; it does not fabricate missing Production evidence.
Zero-touch source-only Formal-Full remains unclaimed until those domains are separately promoted with required OOS evidence.
